purpose: Authoritative build definition and permanent game-resource identity for HSR Level 2 (15.5 m) — Two-Track Diagonal S-Curve Right.
name: HSR Level 2 (15.5 m) — Two-Track Diagonal S-Curve Right
description: A two-way diagonal S-curve shifts a diagonal line sideways while preserving its entry and exit heading. Native HSR or GHSR track ends; select the matching height and handedness.

provenance.geometry: NAM Team HSR/GHSR texture and deck profiles; SCP procedural junctions and diagonal curves. Height adapters preserve the eight audited native ramp tile models.
provenance.construction: SCP right-hand-running fixed-piece rules and explicit directed Monorail paths; native ramp coordinates retained.
